scope: restore only the additional independent per-gene Ms/Mu min-max axes before numerical scoring
source_moments: own saved spliced/unspliced abundance, binary positive connectivities, self connections, row normalization, float32 moments

affine_relation: saved y = a*x + b; restored state is its source moment x; restored velocity = native velocity / a; translation does not enter velocity
inverse_multiplier: float64 reciprocal of the float32 fitted MinMaxScaler.scale_, without replacing it by a rounded range
forward_requirement: np.array_equal(MinMaxScaler().fit_transform(source_moments), saved_Ms_or_Mu); fail on any mismatch or nonpositive range
cbdir: existing float64 NaN/Inf-to-zero and +/-1e10 cleanup applied after velocity unit restoration; reference-30 graph and registered edges retained
cossim: raw restored prediction versus unchanged velocity_s_true/velocity_u_true; prediction and truth norms both >1e-6; no CBDir cleanup
